pages.title: Port setup
pages.text: Connect the controller to a pipe network and right-click to open its port list. The controller does not need power.$(br2)Enable Output at the source and Input at the destination. Search by machine name or coordinates to jump to the page of the first matching port.

pages.title: Filters and priority
pages.text: Place one actual item in a filter slot. Allow mode accepts that item type; exclude mode rejects it. An empty filter imposes no restriction. Names and circuit designs are not compared.$(br2)Priorities range from -2 to +2. Higher-priority ports are considered first.

pages.title: Forced extraction
pages.text: Forced mode adds extraction access to the full inventory of supported machines. Insertion still follows the normal slot rules.$(br2)It can remove unfinished wafers from assemblers and guards. Industrial batch locks and pending-output input locks still apply. Use normal mode for routine operation.
